title: Field
description: The whole screen is a field of green monospace characters blowing along curl noise, denser where the wind bunches up. Every few seconds the wind gathers them into a word or a Beatles cover in ASCII, holds it, then blows it apart again; move through it to stir the field, type to choose the next word.
intent: ASCII art as weather: about sixteen thousand particles follow a curl-noise wind, their density is counted per character cell and mapped through a glyph ramp sorted by measured ink coverage, and a WebGL pass draws every cell from one glyph atlas. To gather, each particle is given a destination sampled from the target's brightness and released by a front that sweeps across like a gust; filtered-noise wind swells as the field closes.
sources: herb reference board: fa23 Y2K montage (green CRT terminal text)
